summary: US Foods Holding Corp. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing ABL credit agreement. On May 28, 2026, US Foods, Inc. entered into Amendment No. 5, increasing commitments from $2.3B to $2.5B, extending the maturity to May 28, 2031 (subject to a springing maturity date tied to earlier-maturing debt exceeding $300M), and adjusting pricing, covenants, and reporting terms. No board recommendation or advisors are named; this is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation. Watch for future refinancing triggers if term loan or notes remain outstanding.
